tasks.title: Countdown

hints.lines: Go! should print once, after the loop, so put it after the closing }. And stop before 0.
hints.timeout: Is there an update inside the { }? Take one off count each time round.
hints.other: Start value, condition, update: count > 0, and take one off each time.

tasks.title: 7 times table

hints.compile: C# doesn't know what ____ is. Replace it with a question about n, like n <= 12.
hints.lines: You need exactly 12 lines. Should the condition use < or <=?

hints.other: Keep going while total <= 100. Inside the loop, add one to number, then add number to total.
hints.lines: Print two lines after the loop: Last number: and Total:.
hints.spaces: Put a space after each colon inside the speech marks: "Total: " + total.
hints.timeout: Does something inside the loop change total, so the condition can become false?
